Middle East.title: Missile strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island; Trump acknowledges 'minor'/'limited' U.S. strikes
Middle East.location: Qeshm Island, Strait of Hormuz, Iran
Middle East.summary: Reuters (03:30Z), citing Iran's Tasnim news agency, reported two missiles struck Qeshm Island. Asked about strikes on Qeshm, President Trump said the U.S. carries out 'minor strikes', including one on an 'anti-aircraft device' (OSINTdefender), and Al Jazeera reports he said U.S. forces are carrying out 'limited strikes' in Iran. Casualties and damage not reported. Qatar says its mediation continues to prevent escalation (Reuters, 04:50Z). Occurs within the ongoing U.S.–Iran conflict; separate viral claims of large Iranian missile attacks on Israel are unverified and not logged.

South America.title: UPDATE: Paraguay — ex-president Peña moved to Regimiento Escolta Presidencial as detainee; police fire rubber pellets at protesters
South America.summary: Continuation of the Ueno Bank collapse / Peña impeachment crisis. Ñanduti (03:18Z) reports Peña was removed from his residence under police custody and moved to the Regimiento Escolta Presidencial, held as a detainee. ABC Digital and NPY report police fired rubber pellets at protesters outside the residence; unverified posts mention injuries. Reuters reported Pedro Alliana sworn in as president; Anadolu (05:00Z) says Alliana pledged full compensation to 2.94 million Ueno clients whose assets remain frozen. Ex-central bank chief Carlos Carvallo surrendered earlier.
